name: plantipedia
description: Plantipedia - Explore the World of Plants

scripts.build: node --check server.js && node -e "const fs=require('fs'),path=require('path'),cp=require('child_process');const walk=(d)=>fs.readdirSync(d,{withFileTypes:true}).flatMap((e)=>e.isDirectory()?walk(path.join(d,e.name)):path.join(d,e.name));for(const f of walk('js'))if(f.endsWith('.js'))cp.execFileSync('node',['--check',f],{stdio:'inherit'});for(const f of walk('data'))if(f.endsWith('.json'))JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(f,'utf8'));"
